name: J no Higeki Las Vegas Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
original_name: Ｊの悲劇 ラスベガス連続殺人事件
source:
You are a detective in Los Angeles and need to investigate a murder case with a more veteran policeman. Man was murdered in hotel room and had baseball chip in his pocket.

A remake of JACK (1988) game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-february-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名洛杉矶侦探，需要与一名经验更丰富的警察调查谋杀案。一名男子在酒店房间中被杀，口袋里有一枚棒球筹码。

《JACK》（1988）的重制版。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-february-1992.html]vndreview[/url]）
